caption: The drawing depicts a single handled object, likely a bed warmer or brazier, with three different views. The largest depiction is in the lower right and shows the object in full color: it has a long, tapered, dark wooden handle with a turned design and a brass or copper perforated, dome-shaped lid featuring star-shaped holes. The lid is attached to a matching metal pan below it. In the upper left are two smaller line drawings: one is a top view of the pan showing a decorated, scalloped-edged lid with a floral and leafy pattern, and a central bird motif; the other is a side view of the object, illustrating the pan's depth and the handle’s straight attachment. Below these views is a simple scale for measurement. The main colors are shades of brown and brass for the pan and dark grey for the handle, with fine black lines used for the detailed sketches. The overall composition is arranged neatly on a vertical rectangular off-white or lightly yellowed sheet, with light shading and minimal background detail.
title: Warming Pan
